$description: Dreamari primitive tokens for dark mode. Palette and foundation paths intentionally match light mode so semantic aliases remain stable while mode files can evolve independently.

100.$description: Palest brand tint. Hue 213 (Black & Blue, 19 Oct 2026).

200.$description: Light brand tint for selected fills on light surfaces.

300.$description: Sky-blue glow tone; decorative light, never body text on white.

400.$description: Bright sky blue sampled from the Black & Blue references (bloom #599df9).

500.$description: Saturated mid blue; gradient stops and bars.

600.$description: Dusk cobalt, the light-mode primary (21 Oct 2026). White text 6.2:1; as text 5.7:1 on the light page.

900.$description: Very deep blue; dark atmospheric washes.

950.$description: Darkest brand blue; dark feature surfaces.

brand.$description: Dreamari brand-blue ramp, re-hued to 213deg for the Black & Blue look (19 Oct 2026; 600 deepened to dusk cobalt 21 Oct). Every rung that carries text is checked for WCAG AA.

deep.$description: Deep accent blue; same as brand.700.

purple.$description: Retired purple slot: since 19 Oct 2026 it resolves to sky blue. Glows, sparks and gradient stops only, never text.

sky.$description: Secondary action blue, kept from the pre-19 Oct ramp: the Glossary Games cloud tint mixes it, and game worlds keep their own palettes.

100.$description: Primary text on branded dark landing surfaces.

200.$description: Secondary text on branded dark landing surfaces.

600.$description: Accessible secondary text on light surfaces.

neutral.$description: Neutral scale used by text, borders, and surfaces. Untuned Tailwind values are retained exactly to avoid visual regression.

50.$description: Pale amber surface; corrects the legacy CSS name amber-100.

900.$description: Onboarding navy background; corrects the legacy CSS name navy-975.

toast-link.$description: Link colour inside the dark match toast.

amber-12.$description: Amber card glow at 12 percent opacity.

blue-10.$description: Blue selection-card elevation at 10 percent opacity.

black-40.$description: Dark card elevation at 40 percent opacity.

world.$description: The 15-world career taxonomy accent colors, matching the Figma design system's world token collection. Slugs intentionally mirror the Figma variable names even where they diverge from current display labels (e.g. helping-human-services for 'Counseling & Social Work') so the two stay mappable - do not rename to match copy.

arts-media-sport.$description: World accent for Arts, Media & Sport. Identical in light and dark modes by design.

building-construction.$description: World accent for Building & Construction. Identical in light and dark modes by design.

business-money-office.$description: World accent for Business, Money, Sales & Office. Identical in light and dark modes by design.

helping-human-services.$description: World accent for Counseling & Social Work. Identical in light and dark modes by design.

driving-flying-shipping.$description: World accent for Driving, Flying & Shipping. Identical in light and dark modes by design.

factories-making-things.$description: World accent for Factories & Making Things. Identical in light and dark modes by design.

farming-animals-nature.$description: World accent for Farming, Animals & Nature. Identical in light and dark modes by design.

fixing-machines-engines.$description: World accent for Fixing Machines & Engines. Identical in light and dark modes by design.

food-farming-nature.$description: World accent for Food & Cooking. Identical in light and dark modes by design.

health-medicine.$description: World accent for Health & Medicine. Identical in light and dark modes by design.

law-safety-government.$description: World accent for Law, Safety & Justice. Identical in light and dark modes by design.

personal-care-community-services.$description: World accent for Personal Care & Community Services. Identical in light and dark modes by design.

science-research.$description: World accent for Science & Research. Identical in light and dark modes by design.

teaching-learning.$description: World accent for Teaching & Education. Identical in light and dark modes by design.

tech-engineering-design.$description: World accent for Tech & Engineering. Identical in light and dark modes by design.

cta-foundation.$description: Foundation values for the design system's CTA component (Figma 2261:12200), added during the design-system alignment. Named after the Figma semantic variables they mirror; identical across modes to match the live file.

surface-light.$description: Mirrors Figma var(--foreground): the CTA Primary/Default surface.

on-surface-dark.$description: Mirrors Figma var(--background): CTA Primary/Default label.

glass-deep.$description: Mirrors Figma var(--glass-surface-3): CTA Primary/Hover surface.

glass-faint.$description: Mirrors Figma var(--secondary)/var(--border)/var(--glass-surface-2): CTA Secondary family surface and border.

glass.$description: The Figma design system's glass surface set (Semantic.Dark), verbatim from the live variable pull and the dev handoff package - the canonical translucent panel/chip/border recipe for space-background screens like the build flow.

surface-1.$description: Glass rung 1 in dark: near-opaque navy (19/21 Oct 2026).

surface-2.$description: Glass rung 2 in dark: near-opaque navy.

surface-3.$description: Glass rung 3 in dark: near-opaque navy.

surface-raised.$description: Raised glass in dark: the lightest near-opaque navy.

border-raised.$description: Figma var(--glass-border-raised) #ffffff29 - the hairline that pairs with surface-raised. Sits between border (#ffffff17, decorative) and hover (#ffffff2e), so a resting tile has a visible boundary without borrowing the hover state's weight.

night.$description: Figma Semantic.Dark base surfaces/text used by space-background screens, verbatim from the live pull.

decorative.$description: Figma decorative accents from the live pull.

pink-glow.$description: Retired pink slot: since 19 Oct 2026 it resolves to pale sky blue. Glows only.

ink.$description: Success text and icons on the page, 4.5:1 or better (dark).

solid.$description: Success fill for dots, bars and solid badges.

subtle.$description: Success tint behind a chip or banner.

ink.$description: Warning text and icons on the page, 4.5:1 or better (dark).

solid.$description: Warning fill for dots, bars and solid badges.

subtle.$description: Warning tint behind a chip or banner.

ink.$description: Danger text and icons on the page, 4.5:1 or better (dark).

solid.$description: Danger fill for dots, bars and solid badges.

subtle.$description: Danger tint behind a chip or banner.

ink.$description: Info text and icons on the page, 4.5:1 or better (dark).

solid.$description: Info fill for dots, bars and solid badges.

subtle.$description: Info tint behind a chip or banner.

dusk.$description: Dark-mode (Dusk) palette, 21 Oct 2026: a navy sky that brightens toward the horizon, navy surfaces, periwinkle actions with dark ink. Identical in both primitive files; dark semantics point here.

page.$description: Dark page navy (Dusk, 21 Oct 2026). The app background and the landing below the hero.

card.$description: Dark card navy, a step up from the page so cards never read as holes in the sky.

glass-1.$description: Dark glass rung 1. Near-opaque so stars never show through behind text (19 Oct 2026).

glass-2.$description: Dark glass rung 2, one step lighter than rung 1.

glass-3.$description: Dark glass rung 3, the deepest overlay panel.

glass-raised.$description: Dark raised glass, the lightest rung (popovers over cards).

border.$description: Dark hairline: sky blue at 14%, so edges read as light, not grey.

foreground.$description: Dark-mode body ink, a cool off-white.

muted-foreground.$description: Dark-mode secondary ink: white at 82%, about 5:1 on the brightest part of the sky.

periwinkle.$description: Dark-mode primary (21 Oct 2026): the landing's periwinkle, 8.5:1 on the page. Always carries dark ink, never white (2.2:1).

link.$description: Dark-mode text-safe brand blue for links and brand text, about 4.9:1 at the sky's brightest point.

sky-top.$description: Sky gradient, top stop (deep navy). The app backdrop runs top to horizon, never radial from above.

sky-horizon.$description: Sky gradient, brightest stop. Full strength only behind the landing hero; app backdrops cap near #3c608f where text sits.

day.$description: Light-mode palette, 19 to 22 Oct 2026: cool white page, solid white cards, navy ink, dusk-cobalt actions, frost photo scrims. Identical in both primitive files; light semantics point here.

page.$description: Light page, a cool white (was lavender #e4eaf8 before 19 Oct 2026).

ink-muted.$description: Light-mode secondary ink, AAA: 8.0:1 on white, 7.5:1 on the page (21 Oct 2026).

secondary-ink.$description: Ink on light secondary fills and on light photo scrims.

link.$description: Light-mode text-safe brand blue, AAA 7:1 on the page (21 Oct 2026). Fills keep brand.600.

scrim-deep.$description: Light photo scrim base: frost, not white (22 Oct 2026).

scrim-ink-soft.$description: Secondary ink on a light photo scrim.

spacing.$description: Spacing foundations named by pixel magnitude to avoid coupling token paths to Tailwind numbering.

tight.$description: Tight display tracking at a 16px reference size.

sans.$description: Dreamari interface and body font stack.

display.$description: Licensed Dreamari display face for major brand titles, with resilient fallbacks.

world.$description: Per-world display typefaces from the Figma design system's world token collection. Slugs mirror the Figma variable names verbatim - see color.world's description.

arts-media-sport.$description: Display typeface for Arts, Media & Sport (Fraunces).

business-money-office.$description: Display typeface for Business, Money, Sales & Office (Viaoda Libre).

helping-human-services.$description: Display typeface for Counseling & Social Work (Quicksand).

driving-flying-shipping.$description: Display typeface for Driving, Flying & Shipping (Rajdhani).

factories-making-things.$description: Display typeface for Factories & Making Things (Staatliches).

farming-animals-nature.$description: Display typeface for Farming, Animals & Nature (Lora).

fixing-machines-engines.$description: Display typeface for Fixing Machines & Engines (Anton).

law-safety-government.$description: Display typeface for Law, Safety & Justice (Libre Baskerville).

personal-care-community-services.$description: Display typeface for Personal Care & Community Services (Fredoka).

science-research.$description: Display typeface for Science & Research (Source Code Pro).

tech-engineering-design.$description: Display typeface for Tech & Engineering (Science Gothic).

cta.$description: CTA label face from the design system (UI/Body: Bricolage Grotesque SemiBold).
CTA label line-height: 22px over 16px, expressed as a ratio like the other line-heights.
